identity: Ashenward March is the Accord's supply road to the front: a crooked quartermaster sells the rations, the ash woods walk at night, and a poacher marshal sells the March's game back to the army it was meant to feed.

quests.title: A Meal Before the Road
quests.text: Every driver here is willing to leave at once, provided 'at once' comes after supper. Bring me eight Corn for the pot before the next run. I can get a great deal more work out of a full bowl than a stirring speech.

variants.text: Every driver here is willing to leave at once, provided 'at once' comes after supper. Bring me eight Corn for the pot before the next run. I can get a great deal more work out of a full bowl than a stirring speech.

My ramp crews have a long shift ahead, and the breakfast pot is showing its bottom. Bring me eight Corn so they can eat before they lift another beam. Try hauling one on an empty stomach and you will understand my priorities.

quests.lesson: A shared errand, a level only; the zone's early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 'A Meal Before the Road': Corn for the crews before the next run (Toren, Drek).

quests.title: The Reserve Is for Them
quests.text: There is a replacement load on the loading ground at Ashenward Mining Camp, set aside for returning crews. Ready it for issue and report back to me. Some of those people have nothing dry left except the ration they are trying to swallow.

variants.text: There is a replacement load on the loading ground at Ashenward Mining Camp, set aside for returning crews. Ready it for issue and report back to me. Some of those people have nothing dry left except the ration they are trying to swallow.

The reserve on the loading ground at Bannerbreak Mining Camp was promised to crews waiting on replacements. Ready that load for issue, then come back to me. I want the people under our banners to have their share while they can still use it.

quests.lesson: A shared use at the own mining camp's held load, once per faction; free, it needs neither Scrip nor the story; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Draft §3 and §4.2/§4.5 'The Reserve Is for Them': a replacement load already set aside at the camp's loading ground, made ready for issue (Nella, Yarra).

quests.title: A Barrel Is Not a Drinking Cup
quests.text: The water barrels have arrived, but half the queue is waiting for the other half to hand a bucket back. Bring me three Iron Buckets so we can share the water out properly. Empty ones will do; we have managed the wet part.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: The Account of Quartermaster Scrip
quests.text: {name:quartermaster_scrip} is selling our rations under The Accord's own supply seal at the {name:ration_camp}, {dir_from_giver:quartermaster_scrip}. His books say the meals were issued, and my drivers are scraping empty bowls. Kill him and bring me word. I cannot feed a crew on his sums.
quests.completion: Scrip's figures never explained an empty bowl, and now he will sell no more meals out from under us. Requisition Clerk Odren Vell is taking over the convoy books. I will keep counting what actually reaches the pot.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (round61-plan.md §2 point 2: A5's free prerequisite); free, it requires nothing; its one Accord follow-up is A5. The zone's weapon (§2a point 6).

quests.title: Splitbolt Needs Hands
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights needs hands to keep his work going. Go and speak to him; his crews help keep the route usable for our loads. If he says a repair can wait until after supper, make certain you heard him correctly.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: The Grown Road
quests.text: Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate in Glassroot Wilds has carriers waiting for the same supplies I am trying to send. Go and ask what she needs to keep their paths usable. A load can have every stamp on it and still need someone to carry it the last stretch.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Who Comes Back to Last Hedge
quests.text: Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt is waiting on crews as well as deliveries. Speak to her about the help she needs. I count portions before a cart leaves; she knows who is there to eat them when it arrives.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: Party: The Marshal's Receipts
quests.text: {name:red_receipt_marshal} trades in stolen provisions at the {name:poacher_camp}, then offers to sell them back to the people he robbed. Gather a group and kill him, {dir_from_giver:red_receipt_marshal}. The receipts must look very respectable to anyone who did not see the arrows.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone (the poacher hunt before it is gone), a trinket choice as its extra; no story proof lies with him.

quests.title: Every Hand on the Road
quests.text: Scrip is finished, but the transport attacked on its run through the {name:wheelbreak} still needs a proper account. The drivers brought back salvage and wounded, yet the loss sheet tells me only what did not arrive. Secure their transport record at the {name:broken_load}, {dir_from_giver:broken_load}, and take it to Audra Wainholt, the foreman at Ashenward Mining Camp. She knows the crews; I want their work counted before we decide what help to send.
quests.completion: These drivers hauled wounded people home with the material they could save; I will put that beside the losses in our account. Their waiting crews still need tools and supplies, and the drivers need relief. With those needs recorded, I can arrange the right help with Toren instead of sending another load on a guess.
quests.lesson: Chapter 3 of the story arc (story, may chain).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. A5 (story, 34): requires A4 and Scrip's free quest (its one Accord follow-up); turned in at the Ashenward mining camp's foreman, titled Audra Wainholt (K12 A).

quests.title: Bring Me the Account
quests.text: A Causeway convoy's pay was impounded at {name:r20_anchor_071}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_071}, and the clerk who sealed it will not go near it again: the purse is still warm. Unseal it and take what you find to Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch; the pay was meant for his drivers. Bring me the account. I already have enough accusations.
quests.completion: [PH] Toren is to find out who passes such bundles on; Audra Wainholt is named as the source of the real list of needs; Odren Vell is not yet suspected (K2 A: the pay was stopped before it reached the carriers and camp workers). Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 1 (41): the Warmaster's first order; a use at Ashenward March's clash site, turned in at Cinderline Watch.

quests.title: The Price of a Salute
quests.text: The Throng's seal warrants an inquiry; an Undead body proves nothing about who paid it. Nella Hedgeward reports that the dead on The Shattered Line rally to a standard pledged against the same warm coin. Defeat three Brandbound Collectors after dark in the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}, and unpick the pledged standard at {name:r20_anchor_082}. Report to Nella at Last Hedge Redoubt with what the stitching reveals.
quests.completion: [PH] Nella recognises who holds the dead's muster together: Ninepins. Her own free supply work stays separate. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (46): the opener; a corrupted sub-type in the Shattered Line trenches by night and a use at its clash site, turned in at Last Hedge Redoubt.

quests.title: Read Before Accusing
quests.text: Ninepins pledged his standard against the next payment, and The Throng's high war camp sits on the same line, but a seal does not tell us whose hand pressed it. Defeat {captain:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high} at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, and bring me the Throng Captain's Orders. I want their own words before I accuse them of anything.
quests.completion: [PH] The orders show impounded pay and harmed Throng soldiers, wrapped in real Ashenward forms with Odren Vell's countersignature (his former office explained); the Warmaster wants them checked at the Courier's Stump. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (47): behind the lines, solo; the captain of the enemy war camp on The Shattered Line drops his orders (quest drop).

quests.title: A Quiet Audit
quests.text: Their orders hunt the same soot factors and list their own soldiers burned by the seized pay, which came wrapped in genuine Ashenward requisitions countersigned by Requisition Clerk Odren Vell. The false seal of The Throng was stamped on our own paper. This finding stays under seal; The Throng must not learn whose office supplied it. Copy Vell's courier ledger at {name:elandor_glassroot_wilds/couriers_stump}, {dir_of:r20_anchor_036:elandor_glassroot_wilds/couriers_stump}, bring the copy to me and nobody else, and come back for your next orders when you can hold your own on Gravesalt's salt.
quests.completion: [PH] The Warmaster seals the finding about Vell; Audra gets the practical correction for her deliveries, the guild is not blamed; the trail leads on to Borin (K3 A, K4 A). Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 2 (last turn-in): the traitor named; a use at Glassroot Wilds' quest place.

quests.title: Following Vell's Pay
quests.text: Odren Vell took over the convoy books after Quartermaster Scrip fell, then left last season 'to settle arrears', without saying whose. His courier ledger traces branded pay to the Saltroad Deserters in Gravesalt Escarpment, whose Debtjaw Hounds carry the same ember stain. Kill four Debtjaw Hounds by day in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}. Report to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights; he is following the payments into the Last Watch.
quests.completion: [PH] Borin ties the trail to Huskell's watch and can offer free salvage work; the attack on Huskell stays at its later level. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 3 (53): the Warmaster's opener, a corrupted sub-type in the Tombwood by day, turned in at Splitbolt Station.

quests.title: Party: Stonegrudge's Inquiry
quests.text: The captain's orders put War Commander Stonegrudge in charge of The Throng's hunt for the factors, from the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}. A rival inquiry is no invitation to share intelligence, least of all one heading for our requisition office. Gather a party and defeat him among his garrison; he is an elite commander, and I expect a plan that accounts for everyone coming back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite: the war commander the orders name, at his camp's level (raids there open at 57).

quests.title: Party: The Collector Comes Due
quests.text: I entered Odren Vell in the Bastion's roll anyway, with the cause beside his name: "Every name accounted for. His too." Gather a party of two or three and defeat Isquarre the Tithe-Eater at {name:r20_anchor_077}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_077}, where the unsecured debt has given its collector a body of slag and ash. Secure the site before The Throng claims authority over it; our own account of this affair will remain under seal.
quests.completion: [PH] The Warmaster accepts the battle report and asks for the final report; no new item, no new foe. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, the finale (60): the rift boss at Tombroad Ambush, for a group of two or three.

quests.title: Every Name Accounted For
quests.text: Isquarre broke at {name:r20_anchor_077}, but the crack did not, and a collector who loses his body keeps the debt. I have sealed your report with the names you brought back, the clerk's among them. We closed his account. Beneath us, someone turned a fresh page.
quests.completion: [PH] The Warmaster closes the human work (honest pay, supply and the recovered names under clear responsibility; Audra stays at her post, Vell's name stays the Accord's own responsibility, K6 A) and ends with the fixed last line; nothing follows it. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: Main line, the last Warmaster turn-in (the achievement counts this id).

quests.title: [PH] Seed for the Trampled Plots
quests.text: [PH] Toren wants seed potatoes so the outposts' trampled field plots grow something of their own again: bring 8 Potatoes. Real text to follow.

variants.text: [PH] Toren wants seed potatoes so the outposts' trampled field plots grow something of their own again: bring 8 Potatoes. Real text to follow.
[PH] Drek wants seed potatoes for the plots behind the ramps, so not every meal has to be hauled in: bring 8 Potatoes. Real text to follow.

quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft F1, the check's fix: another purpose than border_meal (Corn, the same givers): seed for the field plots, not a meal; the early potion choice.

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft F2: a use at the new recipe place P1 (the Causeway's floodmeadows); the first armor choice of Ashenward and Bannerbreak.

quests.text: [PH] Nella wants it written down at the {name:front_shattered_line/relief_rest} which of her work parties have reported back and where relief is missing. Real text to follow.

[PH] Yarra wants to know which promised reliefs actually arrived: record the returns at the {name:front_shattered_line/relief_rest}. Real text to follow.

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft F4: a use at the new recipe place P2 (the Shattered Line's approaches).

quests.text: [PH] Toren wants the usable stores and tools of a stranded load secured at {name:r20_anchor_079}. Real text to follow.

quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft F3: a use at the free clash site 079; the weapon of Ashenward and Bannerbreak (a solo quest).

quests.title: [PH] Salt for the Stores
quests.text: [PH] Nella needs salt to keep the front's stores from spoiling; the Shattered Line's badlands have it: bring 6 Salt Crust. Real text to follow.
